description: The Travelers Companies, Inc., together with its consolidated subsidiaries, is a holding company principally engaged through its subsidiaries in providing a wide range of commercial and personal property and casualty insurance products and services to businesses, government units, associations and individuals. The Company is incorporated as a general business corporation under the laws of the State of Minnesota and is one of the oldest insurance organizations in the United States, dating back to 1853, with principal executive offices at 485 Lexington Avenue, New York, New York, and it also maintains executive offices in Hartford, Connecticut and St. Paul, Minnesota.
